notes.title: Funguys Swarm - THE THIRD BLOG
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]HEYO! Welcome to the September 2025 Funguys Swarm Dev Update! [/p][p]First, we want to thank everyone for the support you've shown during our Early Access Launch! We had a good launch, and we really want to thank everyone for it![/p][p]
This month, we'll be talking about Ersa and her skills, dive into the Sanctuary, and showcasing our second arena, the Frozen Pond. We’ll also give you a peek at what’s coming next, and wrap it all up with a surprise drop at the end.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Early Access Launch Progress[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]Our Early Access launch went great Over 400 reviews so far and sitting at a shiny 96% “Very Positive”![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/d54a45542302db15971c4a72aeb58df35ffd462a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks for all the feedback — the good, the bad, and the weird. We’re taking it all in and already working on improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Re-introducing Ersa[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/26bfdbd4de660e8b402fb78941a78f8e5ba5d9cc.gif"][/img]\[Cute dance, Ersa!][/p][p][/p][p]Meet Ersa, our little dewdrop hero. She’s squishier than Shroomba, but makes up for it with [b]two regenerating shields[/b]! Take a hit, lose a shield, and watch it grow back while you keep fighting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Character Special Skills: Stinky Trail[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_55f281a0518c4a47abb9beb4ca8ade6e~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]\[Stinky Minky][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Arena Showcase: Frozen Pond[/u][/h2][p][/p][h2][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_1e4ca4dfd6ac42aa9d0749ac7afa2883~mv2.gif"][/img][/h2][p]Brrrr… this used to be a cozy pond, but now it’s an ice rink of chaos. Slippery floors, frozen fish charging at you like torpedoes — try not to wipe out while you skate for your life![/p][p][/p][p][b]Enemy 1:  Slider[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_b90b70ed534440c29d07f5550cf70b25~mv2.gif"][/img]\[Fast. Slippery. Slightly smug][/p][p][/p][p][b]Enemy 2: Big Whale[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_6d36de4b1d274b4dadf5336889306a01~mv2.gif"][/img]\[Heavy Ho][/p][p][/p][h2][u]What we've been working on: [/u][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve been cooking up a new arena, a shiny new weapon system, and… something electric. Here’s a little sneak peek:[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Arena Showcase: Lava Jungle[/u][/h2][p][/p][h2][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_6d540738c4754b038ec5704d3d00b723~mv2.gif"][/img][/h2][p]Watch your step! The Lava Jungle’s crawling with wild creatures, juicy fruits, giant bones, and oh yeah… lava that’s hotter than the Fire King himself![/p][p][/p][h2][u]Beep Bop Ze-ep[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_29ebbbbf012d40d2a1c4233e167d66c0~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Something electric is coming (and slightly starchy)[/p][p][/p][h2][u]What is new this month:[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve heard you love the tunes, so we’re dropping the Funguys Swarm soundtrack! Snag it in MP3 or FLAC for crisp beats.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Our favorite tunes:[/b]
Have a listen to our team's favorite, [b]Bossa de Shroomba[/b]:
[url="https://soundcloud.com/funguys-swarm/bossa-de-shroomba"]Stream Bossa de Shroomba by Funguys Swarm | Listen online for free on SoundCloud[/url]
[i]Can you guess where this plays in the game? 

[/i]
[b]How to get it:[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]The soundtrack will launch at USD $1.99. You can get them by clicking the image below[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4005050/Funguys_Swarm_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This first release includes 10 songs — and we’ll keep adding more as the world of Funguys Swarm keeps growing![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't got the game, you can also get the bundle to get both and the game with an added 10% discount here:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59625/Funguys_Swarm_OST_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][u]What is next?[/u][/h2][p]That’s all for now, folks! Next time we’ll be showing off:[/p][olist][*][p]A complete showing of Lava Arena. [/p][/*][*][p]In depth explanation of the new revamped weapon system. [/p][/*][*][p]Who is this electric fella? [/p][/*][*][p]and many more![/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][b]Thank you,  [/b][/p][p]Stairway Games[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1-EarlyAccess+159798
notes.content:
[p]Hi Funguys,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re addressing some of the feedback and bugs found by the community in this update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Community Feedback Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Winning a Run no longer removes your current Fire Curse (THE FIRE KING THANKS YOU FOR YOUR LOYALTY).[/p][/*][*][p]Rerolling Skills and Mutations can no longer show the same option.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugs You Helped Us Catch:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed rerolling Dew at max level resulting in a blank Skill Card offer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed equipped Pet icon sometimes not appearing correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Keybind Hint sometimes not appearing correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Douse Dew quest appearing when the player has no Fire Curse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Chestnut from Elites sometimes dropping inside a building.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Soulboom: Sweet Release not dealing damage on dash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inability to move the cursor in the Shroomshop when using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed locking Dew at max level resulting in a UI softlock.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
General Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed various VFX & SFX issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various UI issues.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]✨ Thanks to all your feedback and bug reports, Funguys Swarm keeps getting better with every update. Keep the feedback coming — together we’ll keep making the game even juicier! 🍄💥[/p][p]— Stairway Games[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Funguys Swarm is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
[p]Heya All,[/p][p]The wait is over—[b]Funguys Swarm Early Access is LIVE[/b]![/p][p][b]$4.99[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Steam: [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3371770/Funguys_Swarm/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3371770/Funguys_Swarm/[/url][/p][p][b]Epic Games Store:[/b] [url="https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/funguys-swarm-1f96a8"]https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/funguys-swarm-1f96a8[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who played the demo and shared feedback—your support has been incredible. You’ve not only helped shape the game, but also fueled our fight against the Fire King’s fiery minions. And of course, to the entire Funguys Swarm team: we made it to Early Access! That’s huge. Congrats and thank you for the hard work![/p][p][/p][h1][b][u]Early Access Trailer[/u][/b][/h1][previewyoutube="nLpI4qyza_c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hope you enjoy it! What do you all think? Let us know![/p][p][/p][h1][b][u]Early Access Content[/u][/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s waiting for you in Early Access:[/p][list][*][p][b]2 cute characters[/b]: You know Shroomba, now meet Ersa (new)![/p][/*][*][p][b]2 biomes[/b]: Carrot Farm & Frozen Pond (new) ❄️[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 weapons[/b]: Throwing Grapes, Watermelon Axe, and Garlic Hammer (new)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loads of wacky skills[/b] (Only one way to find out!).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/26bfdbd4de660e8b402fb78941a78f8e5ba5d9cc.gif"][/img][/p][p]\[Hi Ersa!][/p][p][/p][p]And this is just the beginning—more updates, characters, and biomes are coming in future patches.[/p][p][/p][h1][b][u]Funguys Swarm x Coral Island Crossover[/u][/b][/h1][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch, we’re teaming up with our friends at Coral Island for a special collaboration![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/75a1d4751730096bd69a7924777ccec691ad245b.png"][/img][/p][p]Every purchase of Funguys Swarm comes with a code you can redeem in Coral Island for:[/p][list][*][p]Fungarian Outfit[/p][/*][*][p]Fungarian Chest & Crafting Recipe[/p][/*][*][p]Mythical Pet Outfit: Rusdy 🐕✨[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Redemption details in the FAQ below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/a7e4a4de7b59ac11db48632360758bb1d0ba868c.gif"][/img][/p][p]\[Just [b]five bucks [/b]gets you a wild bullet-hell adventure [i]and[/i] exclusive Coral Island goodies. Best deal since sliced bread (my [b]mom<3 [/b]said so).][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b][u]FAQ[/u][/b][/h1][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will the progress I made in the demo be passed to the game, or is it a reset?[/b][/p][p]A:  All progress will be carried over. Every currency is refunded (such as Shroom, Dew, and Shard). Skills that are unlocked in the Demo will be unlocked in EA right away.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will there be achievement?[/b][/p][p]A: Not yet in Early Access! But there will be achievements in v1.0![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How much does the game cost?[/b][/p][p]A: At the time of Early Access launch, the suggested retail price of Funguys Swarm will be [b]$4.99[/b].
[/p][p][b]Q: Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b][/p][p]A: The price won’t increase during Early Access. For 1.0, the price may increase, but we’re not sure about that yet.
[/p][p][b]Q: How long is Funguys Swarm going to be in Early Access?[/b][/p][p]A: Funguys Swarm will remain in Early Access until we feel confident in the amount of content and overall polish the game delivers. We expect this stage to last [b]around a year[/b], though it may take longer based on player feedback. Keep an eye on our roadmap for updates![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do I report bugs or give feedback?[/b][/p][p]A: In-game, you can select ‘Feedback’ in the Options Menu to report bugs or give feedback that will be sent directly to the development team. You can also share your feedback in the [url="http://discord.gg/stairway"]Stairway Games Discord[/url].[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What about localization?[/b][/p][p]A: Great news! Funguys Swarm is out in Early Access with full support for:[/p][list][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Bahasa Indonesia[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue to improve localization quality and may add more languages depending on how the game is doing.
[/p][p][b]Q: What kind of updates are planned for Funguys Swarm?[/b][/p][p]A: We plan to incorporate new areas to explore, characters to play, more things to do, and more customization options. We’ve put together a roadmap to give you a rough idea of what to expect![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/556f03db8631ed581bfd2cfda1bd32e47b041b1e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What are the PC requirements for Funguys Swarm?[/b][/p][p]A:[/p][p][u]Minimum Specifications:[/u][/p][p]OS: Windows 10 64-bit[/p][p]Processor: Intel I3-7100 or equivalent[/p][p]Memory: 4 GB RAM[/p][p]Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960[/p][p]Details: Low 720p@30fps experience[/p][p][/p][p][u]Recommended Specifications:[/u][/p][p]OS: Windows 10 64-bit[/p][p]Processor: Intel I7-8700K or equivalent[/p][p]Memory: 8 GB RAM[/p][p]Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060[/p][p]Details: High 1080p@60fps experience[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: What about controller support?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes! Funguys Swarm supports controllers.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Can I play Funguys Swarm on Steamdeck?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes! The game isn’t Steam Deck Verified yet, but we’ve thoroughly tested it and it runs well on Steam Deck![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do you redeem the Coral Island goodies?[/b][/p][p]A: You can redeem it by following the instructions below[/p][list][*][p]Click the [b]Coral Island Crossover[/b] button at the bottom right corner.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/0d9ae576e52772b318e6ba1ab919ff0a81b0497a.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Generate the code and copy it. Then click [b]Open Coral Island[/b] to launch the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/27db8e8cde04465c0f2d7e3652f2815078fcd672.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/99c5ad4ba90010c5c09668af17787b2d012f683a.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Click the [b]Meet Rusdy![/b] button at the bottom right corner.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/985bb43baffe8d264fcc14eb03eb384cd31a3eb6.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Paste the code and click [b]Redeem[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/9157b82192d94992a92ba05dcde9472670bc5ee9.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Q: How do I stay up-to-date on Funguys Swarm's development?[/b][/p][p]A: The best way to follow Funguys Swarm’s development is through our daily dev diary on Discord. You’ll also find links there to our dev blogs, where we share more detailed updates. Join us on Discord and be part of the journey![/p][p][/p][p]Discord server:[url="https://discord.gg/stairway"] https://discord.gg/stairway[/url][/p][p]X (ex-Twitter):[url="https://x.com/Funguys_Swarm"] https://x.com/Funguys_Swarm[/url][/p][p]Instagram:[url="https://www.instagram.com/funguys_swarm/"] https://www.instagram.com/funguys_swarm/[/url][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Q: How can I contact support?[/b][/p][p]A: For help, please email us at [url="https://support@stairwaygames.com"]support@stairwaygames.com[/url]. Or, hop into our [b][u][url="https://discord.gg/stairway"]Discord[/url][/u][/b]— one of our community managers will be around. Feel free to tag them or send a DM![/p][p][/p][h2][u][b]Ready to Join the Fight?[/b][/u][/h2][p]Help Shroomba and Ersa take on the Fire King and (hopefully) save the forest![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3371770/Funguys_Swarm/"][/dynamiclink]\[Play Funguys Swarm Early Access Now!][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you,[/b][/p][p]Stairway Games

[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Funguys Swarm - THE SECOND BLOG!
notes.content:
[p]HEYO! Welcome to the July 2025 Funguys Swarm Dev Update! 🍄🔥[/p][p][/p][p]This month, it’s all about combat chaos! Also, a big shout out to everyone who played our demo during Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][h2][u]Steam Next Fest[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]We just wrapped up an incredible week at Steam Next Fest—and what a ride it's been! [/p][p][/p][p]Let’s break down what we showed off:[/p][p]⚔️ 1 playable Funguy, ready to rumble[/p][p]🔫 2 deliciously goofy weapons — the Throwing Grapes and the Watermelon Axe[/p][p]🏟️ 1 epic arena to test your skills. [/p][p][/p][p]We loved watching your runs (and meltdowns 🔥), and your feedback has already sparked some improvements. 🙌[/p][p]Missed the demo? No worries, it’s still live! Dive in and try to survive the swarm.[/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3449620/Funguys_Swarm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h2][u]Meet the Funguys[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]Each Funguy has its own weird and wonderful way of surviving the swarm, whether you're looking for raw power, speedy shenanigans, or pure mayhem, there's a Funguy for you![/p][p][/p][p]First up, let's meet [b]Shroomba[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_9f8890b13fb64d3a80aa690f48f52e62~mv2.gif"][/img][Hi again, Shroomba][/p][p][/p][p][b]Shroomba[/b] is the fearless leader of the Funguys, always ready to charge headfirst into the chaos! [/p][p][/p][p]With his sturdy mushroom cap and positive attitude, he's tough enough to take a hit and strong enough to dish out spore-tacular punishment.

[b]Character Special Skills: Iron Shroom[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_5e9b80a1279b4c6a8fa1ddcb1b10c666~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][Whoosh whoosh whoosh BAM!][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Fruits of Destruction[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]We have 4 weapons:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/1143e049f0c03304cdad44ba86c90763a01d9fcd.png"][/img][Peel the Power][/p][p][/p][p]Each weapon bring themselves a unique skill you can pick from in the arena.  Explain melee and ranged weapons, and how they have specific skills. [/p][p][/p][p]Let's start with the first one, [b]Watermelon Axe.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Watermelon Axe[/u][/h2][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_3cbf4672d859456ea2c5b66b913f5cb0~mv2.gif"][/img][From Farm to Battle, This is Watermelon Axe!][/p][p][/p][p]The watermelon axe is Shroomba's favorite weapon. This weapon also has special skills! Here are 2 out of the 3 special skills that are available when you choose Watermelon Axe.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Watermelon Axe Skill 1: Moon Slash[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_c76e0e8882084985b818fb56393b19bf~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][GETSUGA TENS... Am I allowed to say that?][/p][p][/p][p][b]Watermelon Skill 2: Bubble Jump[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_8392a4ffdb574aadb682aab293a1431a~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][Pop Pop Pop!][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Skills[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]In the arena, as you defeat enemies, defeated enemies will drop XP beans. [/p][p][/p][p]Enemies will drop XP Beans when defeated. Once you have enough XP, you will level up. Every time you level up, you can pick from 3 skills.[/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_ac1b12abeafe4fb092b54a7b87696f1f~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]There are two kinds of skills: Active Skills and Passive Skills.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Active Skills[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_a43b5dc55ac345f2bbb6b6ad590aebac~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][X marks the boom][/p][p][/p][p]Active skills are the skills you pick that immediately give visible skill that can be progressed. Active skills can be leveled up from 1 to 7. Each level up strengthens that particular skill.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Skill Showcase: Passive Skills [/b][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_48714f218d734453aa9a9324afa37e14~mv2.gif"][/img][b]
[/b][Wider reach for all range-based skills][/p][p][/p][p]Passive skills strengthen all the other active skills that synergized with the passive skills. E.g. Wide Reach increase the range of Shockwave (the skill above).[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Arena Showcase: Carrot Farm[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_e9242a21527a4550895db68a7d6a3f99~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to Carrot Farm, the perfect patch for sprouting new survivors! This cozy countryside hideout is free from tricky hazards, making it the ideal spot to get your feet (and maybe your spores) wet.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ENEMY 1: Chilli Pepper[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_fde98160817c4ea297c8d5a9701b53f2~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][Easy to defeat alone, dangerous as swarms][/p][p][/p][p][b]ENEMY 2: Pomegrenade[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_33a91c6578c74a5d97588f1fdef2b774~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][Dangerous up-close - explodes when they get close to you][/p][p][/p][p][b]ENEMY 3: Peashooter[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_2d842ec163104e59975139292849fd96~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][Dangerous from afar][/p][p][/p][h2][u]What's Next[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/833dab656c90f0e60706b93fb07b9a26b5d055e5.png"][/img][/p][olist][*][p]We will be introducing the next hero in Funguys Swarm: Ersa![/p][/*][*][p]What you can buy using resources in Sanctuary[/p][/*][*][p]Highlight one of the shops[/p][/*][*][p]Get back to exploring more things you can get in the arena.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you,  [/b][/p][p]Stairway Games[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix-0.1.5-Demo Version
notes.content:
[p]Hi Funguys![/p][p][/p][p]We're releasing another hotfix with various improvements and fix some bugs in the demo.[/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful for your thoughtful feedback, and we hope this hotfix shall help you rise against the Fire King's Army![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reroll is now bound to the Y button on controller.[/p][/*][*][p]When revived in combat, the player now returns with a full heart (instead of just 1 heart).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Level Selection UI: future game modes no longer display by default — you can now switch between available modes using a button. (More modes coming soon!)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed various localization and button prompt errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Splash Shot damage calculation error introduced by the Shatter rework.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies could become invulnerable when afflicted with both Freeze and Flat status effects.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Best,[/p][p]Stairway Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix-0.1.4-Demo Version
notes.content:
[p]Hi Funguys![/p][p][/p][p]Steam Next Fest is over, thank you SO much for playing and sending in your feedback![/p][p]We’ve just dropped the 0.1.4-Demo Version update to address some of the things you've pointed out. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Skill and Passive cards are now back to have [b]7 levels[/b] instead of 10! [/p][list][*][p]Mutations appear at [b]level 4 and 7. [/b]This means faster pacing, more meaningful upgrades, and more importantly, you get to pick more Mutations per run![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p](NEW) [b]Rerolls[/b]! By popular demand, you can now unlock Reroll Tokens from Starpath that will give you 3 Reroll Tokens every time you go to the Carrot Farm. Best,[/p][p]Stairway Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix-v0.1.2
notes.content:
Hi Funguys,

Thank you so much for all the amazing feedback you’ve shared! We’ve been watching you dive into the fiery swarms, and it’s been a blast!

We’ve cooked up a hotfix based on what we’ve seen and heard to help make Funguys Swarm even better. Keep the feedback coming, you can drop it on our Steam discussions, hop into our Discord, or tag us on social media!

Thanks again for playing the Funguys Swarm demo, we hope you're having as much fun [strike]dying to the swarm[/strike] beating the Appletini!

[h3]Added new Skills:[/h3]
[b]Grape Barrage[/b]: Your Grape weapon now throws an extra projectile.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/8442f5cdcd500eb81e2797ce2c4f888a4aae5590.png[/img]

[b]Thunderspear[/b]: After a number of attacks, you spawn spears in front of you that stab enemies.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/aaf4ff4a59984935b2a76878e776906b2403e285.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New skill progression: start with 2 skill slots, unlock 2 more every 10 levels, up to 6 total.
[*] Skills now mutate at level 5 and level 10 (was level 4 and 7).
[*] [b]Passive cards reworked[/b]:
[list]
[*] No longer upgradeable to Fire Level.
[*] Can now level up to 10 (increased overall effects).
[/list]
[*] [b]Hot Coal[/b] (Fire Skill) temporarily removed.
[*] New icons for different Auto-Attack states.
[*] Adjusted XP bean color variations.
[*] [b]Appletini[/b] now enters Rage Mode at 50% health.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies now correctly move around Manafall crystals.
[*] Auto-Aim system now correctly targets fire totems and special clutters.
[*] Fixed special clutters not showing health bar when damaged.
[*] Fixed Auto-Attack delay when an enemy enters attack range.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing: [/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Stand In Circle[/b] challenge duration reduced:
[list]
[*]Normal: 30s → 25s
[*]Hard: 20s → 15s 
[/list]
[*] Power-up durations (Haste, Amplify Damage, Invulnerability, Resources) reduced to 20s at max level.
[*] Changed Encounter and Swarm timings for Carrot Farm
[*] Balanced enemy health and movement speed
[/list]

[h3]Skills:[/h3]
[u]Stardust[/u]
[list]
[*]Projectile amount: 4–6 → 4
[*]XP drop chance: 10% → 1%–5%
[*][b]TWINKLE STARS[/b] spawn chance: 5% → 1%
[*][b]SPLITTING BOLTS[/b] damage: 60% → 55%
[/list]

[u]Splash Shot[/u]
[list]
[*]Damage: 16–22 → 18–26
[*]Spawn amount: 1–3 → 1–5 projectiles
[/list]

[u]Soulboom[/u]
[list]
[*][b]HERD HUNT[/b] AoE: 200 → 250
[*][b]PRICKLY REACTION[/b] AoE: 400 → 600
[/list]

[u]Thunder Strike[/u]
[list]
[*][b]ELECTRIC LEAPS[/b] radius: 400 → 450
[*][b]ELECTRIC LEAPS[/b] now deals reduced damage on each leap
[*][b]STORMCALL[/b] now strikes 2 additional targets
[/list]

[u]Boomshroom[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]DOUBLE TRIGGER[/b] chance: 20% → 25%
[*] [b]SEED OF DESTRUCTION[/b] now uses pseudo-roll
[/list]

[u]Manafall[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage: 18–30 → 20–30
[*] Amount: 1 → 2–4
[*] Projectile Range: 1000–1600 → 1200–1600
[*] Cooldown: 13s–11s → 10s
[*] [b]STAR LINK[/b] rework:
[list]
[*]No longer gives projectile damage reduction or extra amount
[*]Now deals 25% of the projectile damage as laser
[*]Applies slow if [b]NULLFIELD[/b] is also taken
[/list]
[*][b]IMPACT POINT[/b]:
[list]
[*]Pull range: 400 → 800
[*]Pull duration: 0.5s → 0.85s
[/list]
[/list]

[u]Boulder Bonk[/u]
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 14s–12s → 10s–8s
[*] Damage: 16–28 → 22–38
[*] [b]METEORIC SHARD:[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage: 50% → 65%
[*]Range: 75% → 65%
[*]Reduced visual size
[/list]
[*] [b]METEOR CALL[/b]: cooldown reduced by 1s per 4 XP beans collected
[/list]

[u]Iron Shroom[/u]
[list]
[*]Damage: 16–24 → 14–22
[*][b]FUNGI SONG[/b] damage: 80% → 65% of main damage
[/list]

[h3]Debuffs[/h3]
[u]Shock[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased total damage: ~30 → ~40
[/list]

[u]Mark[/u]
[list]
[*] Explosion damage now scales with the target’s Max HP
[/list]

[u]Starlight[/u]
[list]
[*] Now deals burst damage based on number of hits taken
[*] If target dies from burst, it drops double XP
[/list]

[u]Freeze[/u]
[list]
[*] Frozen explosive enemies no longer explode
[/list]

[h3]Treelings[/h3]
[u]Magnetika[/u]:
[list]
[*]Reduced kill requirements from 800 to 600
[/list]

[u]Punchy:[/u]
[list]
[*]Reworked mechanics: it now reduces your weapon range by -20%, your weapon deals extra damage per health missing from the target (max at 20% HP to deal additional +100% damage)
[/list]

[u]Furiosy:[/u]
[list]
[*] Reworked mechanics: it now temporarily increases you attack speed to 80% for 6s (ignore any additional buffs) after every 300 enemies you killed without taking any damage (The count will be reset upon taking damage)
[/list]

Thanks,
Stairway Team

This month, we’re officially revealing [b]Funguys Swarm[/b]! We’ll be showing off the title screen, revealing the [b]main theme song[/b], and introducing the game and its features. We don’t have an official trailer just yet! But don’t worry—we’re working on it! The announcement trailer should be ready in the coming months. Stay tuned!

[h2][u][b]FAQ[/b][/u][/h2]

[b]Q: Will Funguys Swarm have multiplayer?[/b]
A: Nope! Funguys Swarm is designed as a single-player experience.

[b]Q: Will there be a demo?[/b]
A: Yes! We’re planning a demo so everyone can try the game before launch. More details to come!

[b]Q: What price will Funguys Swarm be sold at? [/b]
A: We plan to launch into Early Access at $4.99, and Full Release at $9.99 to reflect the state of the game's content.

[b]Q: Will there be special bonuses for Coral Island players?[/b]
A: Yes! Funguys Swarm players will get exclusive Coral Island cosmetics.

[b]Q: Will Funguys Swarm receive regular updates like Coral Island?[/b]
A: Yes!  We’ll have regular updates, patches, and improvements throughout Early Access, along with a monthly dev blog to keep you in the loop.

[b]Q: Will Funguys Swarm be released on consoles?[/b]
A: That would be ideal, but right now, we’re focusing only on the PC version for Early Access. 

[b]Q: Will Funguys Swarm affect Coral Island’s development?[/b]
A: No. The two games have separate development teams, and Funguys Swarm’s development does not take away resources from Coral Island. Coral Island updates are still on track!

[b]Q: How long will Funguys Swarm be in Early Access?[/b]
A: We don’t have a set timeframe yet, but we’ll keep you all in the loop!

[b]Q: How can I stay updated on Funguys Swarm?[/b]
A: Follow us on Steam, EGS, social media, and Discord! We even have dedicated channels for Funguys Swarm—come hang out!
